request.description: Edits a draft's `content` or `notes`; problems are recomputed and returned in `issues`. Only drafts can be edited; the database refuses content changes once a version is submitted. Staff only. Question sets are versioned config: draft → submit (maker) → approve or reject (a different staff member, in Change Requests) → publish → retire. Reading needs config read access; making, publishing and retiring need config maker access for question sets (ops lead, super admin).
